title: ARCHITECTS & INTERIORS
subtitle: SPEC-IN ACCOUNTS — interior designers, architects, turnkey fitout firms, joinery and furniture manufacturers. These do not buy once; they specify furniture into every project they win. One good relationship here is worth more than fifty retail orders. Ask what is in their pipeline, not what they need today.
